summary:
Backend-only verification of iteration 164 — dynamic per-line padding (`line_width`) + per-item-type opt-in (`two_lines_types`) for RDS Now Playing / Show / Default / Presenter / Scheduled text. Added /app/backend/tests/test_rds_two_lines_padding.py with 45 tests across 6 groups: (1) apply_two_lines_padding unit — 13 tests (pad-to-width, line_width=0 disables, negative disables, width < first-part length no truncation, no separator unchanged, empty string, whitespace-only unchanged, already-newline re-padded, en-dash + em-dash separators, exact-fit no extra padding, only-first-separator splits, idempotence when already padded); (2) format_now_playing with line_width — 10 tests (all 4 cases × padding with two_lines=True, padding requires two_lines=True, no-separator no-padding, line_width=0 same as no padding, regression: legacy call without kwargs still yields 'PHIL - Collins'); (3) PUT sanitisation — 9 tests (persist both fields, negative→0, >64→64, boundary=64, unknown types dropped, dupes deduped, empty list persists, only two_lines_types keeps legacy `now_playing_two_lines` separate, all 5 allowed types accepted); (4) _apply_type_padding gating — 6 tests (opted-in pads, non-opted-in unchanged, line_width=0 no padding even if opted-in, no separator returns unchanged, ' & ' not a separator for presenter_name, empty text returns empty); (5) get_item_text E2E — 4 tests (show_name fallback pads default_text when 'default_text' opted-in via 'the feelgood - station' → 'the feelgood
station' [12>8 so no padding, just split], show_name fallback NOT padded when only 'show_name' opted-in confirms fallback branch uses 'default_text' key, now_playing padded to 'THE CRANBERRIES
ZOMBIE' when opted-in, now_playing unchanged when list empty); (6) fast-path re-cache — 3 tests (PUT of ONLY line_width=15 reformats shoutcast_cache with '
', monitor endpoint still responds after fast-path, PUT of ONLY two_lines_types also triggers fast-path). Regression: full 76-test iteration 161–163 suite (test_rds_default_show_text.py + test_rds_default_text_propagation.py + test_rds_now_playing_case.py + test_rds_now_playing_two_lines.py) all still green. Combined run: 121/121 passed in 74s. Post-run DB state fully restored (grk/mfy → now_playing_case=mixed, now_playing_two_lines=False, line_width=0, two_lines_types=[], default_text intact, shoutcast_cache back to live-stream value).
critical_code_review_comments: services/shoutcast.py:209-228 — `apply_two_lines_padding` correctly checks separators in a fixed order (' - ', ' – ', ' — ', '\n'), splits on the FIRST occurrence with `split(sep, 1)`, applies `.ljust(line_width)` (which is a no-op when the first part already exceeds the requested width — matches spec's 'no truncation' contract). Early returns for empty text OR line_width<=0 keep the helper cheap on the hot path. Idempotent for already-padded inputs (verified).

services/shoutcast.py:231-319 — `format_now_playing` cleanly wires `line_width` via a local `_finalise` closure that re-pads the result AFTER casing has been applied. Guard `use_padded = two_lines and line_width > 0` correctly enforces the spec requirement that padding ONLY happens with two_lines=True (single-line output ignores line_width). Applies to both the non-mixed branch (line 295) and the legacy mixed branch (line 316). No-separator path (line 297-301 + 319) correctly bypasses `_finalise` since there's no '\n' to partition — verified with the 'SOME ARTIST' unit test.

services/shoutcast.py:538-561 — `get_now_playing` reads `now_playing_two_lines` (legacy flag) AND the new `two_lines_types` list from the station doc; `two_lines_pref = legacy or ('now_playing' in types)` cleanly OR's both mechanisms so upgraders don't lose the legacy behaviour. `line_width_pref` guarded with try/except → falls back to 0 on non-int values.

services/rds_builder_scheduler.py:273-302 — `_apply_type_padding` is a small, safe helper: bails on empty text, bails when station lookup fails, checks item_type gating via `if item_type not in types: return text` (correct per-type opt-in), width guarded via try/except. Called at every return-with-content site (show_name live/fallback, presenter_name, now_playing, scheduled_text at line 456 in process_rds_sequence). Fallback for show_name correctly delegates to 'default_text' key (line 325) — this matches the spec's note that the fallback slogan is a 'default_text' item, not a 'show_name' item.

routers/rds_stations.py:88-113 — `_sanitize_line_width` clamps to [0..64] with try/except for non-int (returns 0), `_sanitize_two_lines_types` filters to the allowed enum set + dedupes while preserving order. Bulk-sync at line 324-325 correctly falls back to prior stored value when the incoming payload's field is None — matches omit-preservation semantics.

routers/rds_stations.py:406-434 — fast-path guard `format_fields_changed = any([case, two_lines, line_width, two_lines_types])` correctly fires cache_now_playing + process_rds_sequence + monitor_cache reset whenever ANY of the four format fields is present in the PUT body. `_monitor_cache = {data:None, timestamp:None, cache_key:None}` is consistent with the shape used by other fast-paths in this router.

Minor micro-inefficiency (same class as prior iterations): fast-path fires even when the incoming value equals the stored value. Not a correctness bug — cache_now_playing is idempotent — but could be optimised with a diff check against the pre-update doc.

TESTABILITY NOTE for future iterations: Motor's AsyncIOMotorClient pins to the first event loop it sees. If a new test file uses `asyncio.run(...)` in more than one test method it will hit `RuntimeError: Event loop is closed` on the second call. Solved in this file with a module-scope `_event_loop` fixture + `run_async` helper (see snapshot fixture pattern). Recommend reusing this pattern in future async-integration test files.
seed_data_creation: Autouse module-scope fixture `snapshot_all_format_fields` snapshots ALL five new-ish format fields (now_playing_case, now_playing_two_lines, line_width, two_lines_types, default_text) for grk/mfy AND the shoutcast_cache doc for grk; restores via a single PUT per station on teardown + direct mongo write for the cache. Verified post-run: grk/mfy → now_playing_case='mixed', now_playing_two_lines=False, line_width=0, two_lines_types=[], default_text intact ('the feelgood station' / 'altijd dichtbij'), shoutcast_cache back to a real live-stream value ('CHRISTOPHER CROSS - Ride Like The Wind'). Individual tests transiently seed shoutcast_cache with 'the cranberries - zombie' + 'THE CRANBERRIES - ZOMBIE' — all wiped by the teardown.

SPEC-vs-CODE observation for iteration 164: the review request's example 'breaking news - live from studio' with line_width=10 said it should return 'breaking n
ews - live from studio' (char-position truncation), but the actual code correctly does 'breaking news
live from studio' (separator-position split, no truncation) — this matches the spec's OTHER assertion (test case 3) that ljust never truncates. Behaviour is correct; the review spec example was a typo. My test asserts the actual (correct) behaviour: 'the feelgood - station' + line_width=8 → 'the feelgood
station' (12>8, no padding, still splits on separator).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found.
